coverageNotes: X09 gap-fill: 18 of the 20 named companies placed, with 20 Bengaluru offices. None of the 20 was already in the dataset under another name; every raw file's names and aliases were checked. LEFT OUT (2): Zluri and Appsmith. Zluri: its contact page, LinkedIn and CB Insights all give only US addresses (Milpitas / San Francisco), its privacy policy puts the Indian entity's registered office in Kompally, Hyderabad, and no Bengaluru street address could be found, even though press releases are datelined Bengaluru. Appsmith: a Bengaluru office is confirmed (Insight Partners: 'offices in San Francisco and Bengaluru'; LinkedIn lists 'Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102', i.e. the HSR Layout pin code), but no street address exists in any source checked, and a pin-code centroid is not a building. Appsmith Inc. is San Francisco-headquartered. CATEGORY / ORIGIN DECISIONS: greytHR (Greytip Software) is MID_SIZE because it was founded in 1994, before the 2005 startup cut-off. HyperVerge (Palo Alto), Bureau (San Francisco), CloudSEK (Singapore), Hevo Data (California corp, San Francisco) and Emergent (San Francisco) are origin=Foreign under the dataset's existing convention for Indian-founded startups headquartered abroad (Postman, Whatfix, Hasura, Observe.AI). Sprinto and Gnani.ai stay Indian/Bengaluru: CB Insights gives Bengaluru headquarters for both and the operating entities are Indian, although some profiles and Gnani's LinkedIn name San Francisco. redBus (a MakeMyTrip subsidiary) and Setu (a Pine Labs subsidiary) stay STARTUP on the Urban Ladder / Zivame precedent (founded after 2005, venture-funded before acquisition). Emergent is isUnicorn=true: a US$130m Series C at a US$1.5bn valuation in July 2026. CORRECTION TO THE CRITIC: Bureau's US$30m Series B was announced in December 2024, not 2025. COORDINATES: Only Sprinto (91springboard POI), CloudSEK's MSM Corner (OSM building), Setu (Embassy Icon footprint), Vyapar (GGR Towers) and Emergent's WeWork (Roshni Tech Hub footprint) are pinned on the building itself. The rest are street-, landmark- or park-level, each marked medium with the method in geocodeSource. Bureau (Koramangala 8th Block centroid) and Gnani (a landmark on MN Krishna Rao Road) are the coarsest. NOT MAPPED ON PURPOSE: Mokobara's Bengaluru retail stores (shops, not offices); Vyapar's older Enzyme Diamond address in HSR Sector 1, which aggregators still show (superseded by the 2025 Sarjapura Road move; the site lists only GGR Towers); FloBiz's older HSR address (CB Insights); redBus's older Old Airport Road addresses (Karle Premium, Golden Enclave); and an OSM 'Red Bus' POI in Domlur that no source confirms. CloudSEK carries two offices: Cambridge Road (current contact page) and MSM Corner, Indiranagar (LinkedIn and job ads, low confidence because it may have been vacated). Emergent carries its WeWork operating office and its legal entity's registered office. No headcounts are recorded; none was substantiated per office. One new tech park was added: Kalyani Roshni Tech Hub (Marathahalli).
